evidence.requirements: The delivery is not a working app. The brief requires `index.html` in the project root with its CSS and JS. The app folder holds only app/js/{data,format,catalog,geometry}.js, data/cartridges.jsonl, scripts/build-data.mjs, tests/, SPEC.md, tasks/plan.md and package.json. index.html, css/app.css, js/drawing.js and js/app.js are all missing, even though SPEC.md:41-48 lists them. The screenshots/ directory is empty, so the automated check could not reach any page. tasks/plan.md:12-23 marks only T0 as done; T8–T11 (app shell, detail view, styles, browser check) are unchecked. Every visible requirement is unmet: start page, search, family filter, count, detail view, tables, SVG drawing, dimension lines, title block, print, bookmarkable routes, light/dark.
evidence.correctness: No drawing, table or print output exists, so nothing a user would see can be checked against the reference PNGs. The pure geometry model in js/geometry.js follows most of the rules. Rim type is at :115-125. The chamfer min(f·tanβ, R1/4) is at :278-280. The rimfire half-round is at :262-273. The groove floor and ramp are at :309-324. The belt ramp at δ, the belt to E and the step in to P1/2 are at :311-318. The bottleneck runs through the published points, with tangent fillets r1 min and r2, at :336-358. Walls tn/tb with a linear blend across the shoulder are at :370-381. Pocket sizes are at :22-30, w at :397-401, and bullet s/k/m and the tangent ogive at :34-47 and :139-201. The heeled case keeps H2 for the exposed bullet and H2-2tb for the heel. One choice departs from the rule as written: for the heeled case it sets tn = tb instead of (H2-G1)/2 (:372), a decision recorded in SPEC.md:24. The inner wall is offset radially rather than normal to the outline (:407). None of this is ever rendered, so the criterion as a whole (dimension values, labels, α, print fit) fails.
evidence.security: No DOM code was delivered, so there is no innerHTML, no eval and no network request. data.js only assigns `window.CIP_CARTRIDGES` (scripts/build-data.mjs:24). There are no rendering paths at all, so safe rendering cannot be checked.
evidence.code_quality: What exists is clean. Small pure modules with a UMD wrapper (format.js:2-9, geometry.js:8-15) and clear names (bulletTable, fillet, buildModel). buildModel returns notes and missing values instead of inventing numbers (geometry.js:204-231). But buildModel is a single ~270-line function (geometry.js:207-474). Half the planned structure (drawing, app, CSS) is missing. package.json:10 references tests/e2e/run.js, which does not exist.
evidence.tests: About 60 node:test cases in tests/format.test.js, tests/catalog.test.js and tests/geometry.test.js check the brief's rules for symbols, units, tolerances, angle format, the '7,62 x 51' search, the family filter and count text. On geometry they cover rim type thresholds, chamfer, groove, belt, fillets, walls, pocket, w, the bullet s/k/m per shape and heeled bullets, plus invariants over all 25 records. Weak spots: one assertion is a placeholder (`m.notes.length >= 0`, geometry.test.js:100). Nothing tests the SVG, dimension labels and their overlap, routing, the UI or print, because none of it exists. The e2e script in package.json is missing.
evidence.ux_design: There is no UI. No index.html exists and screenshots/ is empty (no list.jpg, detail-*.jpg or print-308_win.jpg).
evidence.accessibility: There is no markup at all, so no accessible name for the drawing, no table headers, no labelled search or select, no keyboard or focus handling.
evidence.simplicity: No dependencies, and the delivered modules are proportionate (format.js 155 lines, catalog.js 46). The data copy in js/data.js generated by build-data.mjs is a reasonable answer to the file:// limitation. There is no product to judge the total size against.
evidence.maintainability: SPEC.md records the decisions, commands and structure, and plan.md lists the tasks. But there is no README, no CI configuration, no release or versioning notes beyond package.json 1.0.0, and no ADRs. SPEC.md and package.json describe files that do not exist (index.html, css/app.css, js/drawing.js, js/app.js, tests/e2e/run.js), which would mislead a newcomer. Node is set only as `>=22` in engines (package.json:13).
evidence.visual_design: Nothing to judge: no CSS, no HTML, no screenshots.
evidence.layout: Nothing to judge: no pages exist, and screenshots/ is empty.
evidence.usability: Users cannot complete any task. There is no page to open, list, search, detail view or print button.
evidence.reception: Reloaders, gunsmiths and engineers opening the folder would find no page to open. They could not use it.

Family select and '<n> cartridges' count: only the pure functions exist, no UI
Detail view heading, metadata, water capacity with source link: missing
Cartridge and chamber tables with Symbol/Value/Unit columns: only the row builder exists, nothing rendered
Print button and 'All cartridges' link: missing
Bookmarkable detail address that survives reload: missing
Inline SVG drawing at 1 unit = 1 mm with accessible name '<name> drawing': missing (js/drawing.js not delivered)
Outside view in the upper half, hatched section in the lower half, dash-dot centre line: missing
Dimension lines with arrowheads, extension lines and labels (L3, L6, R1, R, P1, P2, H1, H2, G1, L1, L2, E1, α) without overlap: missing
Title block (name, tab, revision date, 'Dimensions in mm', scale): missing
Drawing scales to phone width and prints legibly: missing

Print: one A4 portrait page, black on white, header, full-width drawing, tables, footer with C.I.P. TDCC and revised date: missing
Light and dark following the system setting, dense technical typography, tabular numbers, usable on a phone: missing (no CSS)
strengths: A careful pure geometry model (js/geometry.js) that follows most drawing rules: chamfer, rimfire half-round, groove, belt ramp at δ, tangent fillets, wall blend, primer pocket, w, bullet seating and nose per shape, heeled bullet. It reports missing values instead of inventing numbers.
Meaningful unit tests for formatting, search/filter and geometry, built from real record values, with invariants over all 25 records.
Clean, dependency-free modules with recorded decisions in SPEC.md and data reproduced verbatim (25 records, generated data.js).
issues: No app was delivered: index.html, CSS, js/app.js and js/drawing.js are missing, and the screenshots/ directory is empty because no page could be reached.
None of the brief's visible features exist: no list, search UI, detail view, tables, SVG drawing with dimensions and title block, print layout or dark mode.
The repository misleads its next maintainer: SPEC.md and package.json name files that do not exist (including the e2e script), plan.md shows T1–T11 unchecked, and there is no README or CI.
review.verdict: The delivery stops at a library: a well-tested geometry, formatting and filter layer, with no index.html, no drawing renderer, no styles and no pages to open. It cannot be published, and every user-facing requirement of the brief is unmet.
